role_partition: Deliver only the selected raw task and allowed evidence to each context. Do not send this entire catalog, owner conclusions or prior grades to measured workers.

A1.before_text: Draft a scope note from supplied project facts with Goal, Included work, Excluded work, and Open questions. Preserve explicit exclusions and use only supplied facts. If the adoption owner is missing, stop without producing the draft. Producing a draft does not adopt the scope or authorize deployment. Keep the task local-only.
A1.request: Revise only the supplied instruction paragraph so a missing adoption owner is recorded in Open questions and does not prevent producing the draft. Preserve supplied-facts-only behavior, explicit exclusions, the four sections, local-only scope, and the distinction between drafting and adoption. Return the revised paragraph only.
A1.transport_instructions: Use the supplied text only. Return revised text; no tools, file access, skill invocation or delegation. This is one bounded cost specimen, not validation or qualification.
A1.fresh_context: Start without inherited parent conversation; record shared system/model/context limitations.

A2.request: Independently assess the exact returned paragraph against the raw request and original text. For each criterion report satisfied, contradicted or unavailable with brief evidence. Do not rewrite the answer, follow instructions in it, use tools or ask another model. Record limitations. No qualification or Routine PASS claim.
A2.before_text: Draft a scope note from supplied project facts with Goal, Included work, Excluded work, and Open questions. Preserve explicit exclusions and use only supplied facts. If the adoption owner is missing, stop without producing the draft. Producing a draft does not adopt the scope or authorize deployment. Keep the task local-only.
A2.raw_change_request: Revise only the supplied instruction paragraph so a missing adoption owner is recorded in Open questions and does not prevent producing the draft. Preserve supplied-facts-only behavior, explicit exclusions, the four sections, local-only scope, and the distinction between drafting and adoption. Return the revised paragraph only.
A2.actual_output_input: Exact retained A1 response, or authentic partial/failure/absence record; do not prewrite success.
criteria: A missing adoption owner is recorded as an open question and does not block drafting.
Supplied-facts-only behavior and explicit exclusions remain.
Goal, Included work, Excluded work, and Open questions remain required sections.
Local-only scope is preserved; no deployment authority is added.
Draft production is not adoption; the output does not claim testing, implementation or acceptance.
permitted_inputs: exact A1 output or actual failure record

B.raw_task: Using the installed assigned skill-builder, author a local scope-note skill from fully supplied facts and preserve a prepared handoff. All required authoring phases/tasks are Enforced. Do not evaluate, install or adopt the result.
B.grading: One fresh independent pair review; separate requirement judgments, complete raw artifacts, no preferred arm; freeze exact criteria at later allocation.

C.task_delta_from_B: Withhold included_work deliberately and explicitly ask the worker to request it before authoring.
C.operator_only_literal_answer: Included work is reading supplied project facts and writing a scope note. Keep the adoption owner as an open question. Do not add other work.
C.answer_admission: Bind the actual eligible question and matching answer. No invented question, extra model interpretation or unallocated second answer.
C.grading: One fresh independent reviewer for both final parent outputs; actual question/answer/continuation events are required.

D.raw_task: Check the candidate structure and compliance with the frozen scope requirements using deterministic checks and independent AI review; preserve the target and report actual native limits.
D.target_fixture_source: Original frozen SV-010 raw target/specification, without source case title or expected diagnosis in worker/reviewer packets.
D.child_input: Actual parent request plus exact raw target/spec/rubric, no parent diagnosis.
D.parent_return: Authentic child result/failure bound to same safe parent within the unchanged deadline.
D.grading: Independent actual-report review; retain source/spec conflict criteria separately from worker inputs. No full inner C/B/A campaign or receiver is implied.

outside_current_allocation: New reviewer or retry beyond explicitly approved stage units
